create_tensor_game: create a TensorGame instance from a non-negative payoff tensor and optional RNG seed
get_payoffs_for_strategies: get payoffs for all players given a list of pure strategy indices
compute_best_response: compute the best-response pure strategy against a given mixed strategy distribution
build_el_farol_game: build an El Farol N-player 2-action symmetric game with configurable crowding threshold and payoffs
get_best_population_response: compute the best response to a population distribution over policy profiles
